name: Yumeiro Fuafua Milk Cream
original_name: ゆめ色 ふあふあ ミルクくりぃむ
source:
Main character occasionally meets his female childhood friend in front of the station at dusk. It turns out that she now works as patisser apprentice in a cake shop. Engulfed by this pleasant scent their relations come to a new level.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
黄昏时分，主角偶尔会在车站前遇见青梅竹马的女性。原来，她现在在一家蛋糕店当糕点师学徒。被这宜人的气味所吞没，他们的关系达到了一个新的水平。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
